posts.t:
Morning Pucci, are you ready for a question yet?

It's just regarding the FL. Tried to keep it simple on the chart. It seems the definition of how to define a FL is mixed, and a lot of the time in the same chart. My main issue is with the assumption that an engulf of a FL, followed by the engulf of the high or low created is another FL, But surely this cannot be possible, that would just be an FTR? This decision has to be made before the engulf, if only 1 pip before. If this rule is applied going to in direction I don't understand how it can't be applied in the other, it kind of defines logic.

So much for this being short!

Hope you see what I mean!

Cheers,

Robbie

فقط دربارهٔ FL است. سعی کردم روی چارت ساده نگهش دارم. به نظر می‌رسد تعریفِ چگونگی تعریف یک FL مختلط است و خیلی وقت‌ها در یک چارتِ واحد. مشکل اصلی من با این فرض است که اینگالف یک FL و به‌دنبال آن اینگالفِ سقف یا کفِ ایجادشده یک FL دیگر است؛ ولی این قطعاً نمی‌تواند درست باشد، آن وقت فقط یک FTR می‌شد؟ این تصمیم باید قبل از اینگالف گرفته شود، حتی اگر فقط 1 پیپ قبل باشد. اگر این قاعده در یک جهت اعمال می‌شود نمی‌فهمم چرا در جهت دیگر نمی‌شود؛ این‌طور منطق را تعریف می‌کند.

posts.t:
Hi Robbie,

For simplicity's sake let's suppose we have only one TF, this is how I define the following:

FL = RBR or DBD FTR= RBD or DBR

Do you understand Harry's statement "The Flag Limit is an FTR. But not all FTRs are flag limits"???

Do you understand IF's statement "Sometimes we have to consider the whole candle as a FL/decison"???

If you haven't come across these yet, or maybe you may have accidentally dismissed their importance, go back to them and study them.

To me the important decisions are the ones where price decides to stay above a certain level after it has breached it.

If I were you, I'd go through all of the material offered here from the top. Then I'd read as many of the seniors threads as possible while taking notes. Then once you think you're ready dissect a whole currency like I have done with the EURUSD last year.

I hope this will help you buddy,

Cheers

Thank for your reply Pucci,

I see it exactly the same;

FL = RBR or DBD FTR= RBD or DBR

Yes, I've came came across them both, and feel i understand them both. With regards to the FL being an FTR but not all FTRs being FLs, this makes total sense.

I think where I was coming from is that I see different interpretations of FL's, even from some of the masters, the problem is I think i've read too much meaning I can't find the definitive answers. For instance, I see the the orange DBD and and RBR if your chart, they are by definition the same.

I feel the engulf of the FL is important because it is the end of momentum, the conviction of the buying/selling is ending/has ended. Upon return to the FL we form an area where a decision is being made, accumulation/distribution, the engulf of the FL shows intent, the pressure cooker has burst a little as the buying or selling pressure gets too much.

I think I might be irritating you slightly with my questions, apologies for that, it's not my intention all all. I just totally agree with some of the things you say i.e. the FL being the decision to engulf.

Cheers for all of your help, patience is a virtue! I'll leave my questions there for now. You have actually improved my trading today massively, 'preservation of capital', it's always been in my mind and i've always applied it to some extent. I'm looking at the same possible trades with different eyes and an improved mindset.

Robbie
posts.fa:
ممنون از جوابت ای Pucci،

من دقیقاً همان را می‌بینم؛

FL = RBR یا DBD و FTR = RBD یا DBR

بله، هر دو را دیده‌ام و فکر می‌کنم هر دو را می‌فهمم. دربارهٔ اینکه FL یک FTR است ولی همهٔ FTR‌ها FL نیستند، این کاملاً منطقی است.

فکر می‌کنم جایی که من از آنجا می‌آمدم این بود که تفسیرهای متفاوتی از FL‌ها می‌بینم، حتی از بعضی استادها؛ مشکل این است که فکر می‌کنم بیش از حد خوانده‌ام و نمی‌توانم جواب قطعی را پیدا کنم. برای مثال، آن DBD و RBR نارنجی را در چارتت می‌بینم؛ از نظر تعریف یکی هستند.

فکر می‌کنم اینگالف FL مهم است چون پایان مومنتوم است؛ قناعت خرید/فروش دارد تمام می‌شود/تمام شده. با بازگشت به FL ناحیه‌ای می‌سازیم که در آن تصمیمی در حال گرفته‌شدن است، انباشت/توزیع؛ اینگالف FL قصد را نشان می‌دهد، دیگ فشار کمی ترکیده چون فشار خرید یا فروش خیلی زیاد شده.

فکر می‌کنم شاید با سؤال‌هایم کمی اذیتت می‌کنم، برای این عذرخواهی می‌کنم، اصلاً قصدی نداشتم. فقط کاملاً با بعضی حرف‌هایی که می‌گویی موافقم؛ یعنی FL همان تصمیم برای اینگالف است.

ممنون از همهٔ کمکت، صبر فضیلتی است! سؤال‌هایم را فعلاً همان‌جا می‌گذارم. در واقع امروز تریدم را به‌شدت بهتر کردی؛ "حفظ سرمایه"، همیشه در ذهنم بوده و تا حدی همیشه اعمالش کرده‌ام. الان با چشم‌های متفاوت و ذهنیت بهتری به همان تریدهای ممکن نگاه می‌کنم.

Robbie

posts.t:
Hi Robbie,

You're not irritating me at all, on the contrary

As it was once explained to me, as price is going up for instance it will keep on making FL after FL. Now those maybe local FLs. The importance of an engulfed FL is the continuation of price in the direction of that engulf thus creating a new IMPORTANT FL. As you may know we have important and non-important FL.

A FL may get engulfed several times, but if I don't see a continuation in the direction of any of the engulfs I will not touch that.

The question I posted in Art's thread is not related because we had CP on approach after the ENG, thus a trade could be considered before a LL was printed.

Hope this helps,

FL = FTR and FTR = FL as said by IF I translate in the following way,

Say we are looking at an H4 chart and we see a FL. How will that FL look on a smaller TF? A RBD/DBR = FTR

The opposite is true as well.... i.e. suppose we are looking at M1 and we see what looks like a DBR/RBD FTR as a swing. How will that look on say H4???? Same same; different TFs, that's all.
